policy.causal_rule: Descriptive sentiment is not a price forecast. Feature-quality defects must be tested for their effect on out-of-sample performance; a proposed code change is not a deployed fix.

edges.claim: Main workflow still schedules every 30 minutes and commits/pushes state/log. Persisted position_size is nonzero while position_product is null, so repeated cycles can mutate state whose product identity is unresolved.
PR #1325 removes recurring schedule and validates persisted identity before provider/model calls; exact-head CI and gate passed. Draft/unmerged means main remains active.

Main can fabricate score/confidence on malformed JSON; when providers fail it may still blend news score while confidence is zero. Output lacks forecast_status, target, horizon and calibrated probability. Current artifact is not a valid forecast.

PR #1326 rejects malformed schemas, invalid/missing/timezone-naive timestamps, non-finite/nonpositive relevance weights and unknown labels, and marks outputs NOT_ISSUED absent a calibrated fixed-horizon model. Exact-head CI/gate passed; not merged.
High headline sentiment does not establish incremental predictive value for XRP returns; leakage-safe walk-forward comparisons against price/volume baselines are required.

hypotheses.statement: Timestamp-valid, deduplicated XRP news sentiment may add incremental short-horizon information beyond price/volume baselines.
disconfirming_evidence: Current signal score 44/confidence 0.0 is not a forecast; current headline selection is narrow and model providers failed.
tests_needed: Freeze features at each cutoff; deduplicate events; compare baseline versus baseline-plus-news using walk-forward splits, ablation, calibration and untouched holdout.

hypotheses.statement: Current headline score may be non-predictive or already priced in, especially for technical XRPL papers whose relation to short-horizon XRP returns is indirect.
disconfirming_evidence: A controlled event study could find incremental signal; no such study has yet been admitted.
tests_needed: Compare source-specific event windows and deduplicated features against price/volume and BTC/market controls using walk-forward out-of-sample evaluation.
